newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Grand Hotel Group tops turnover lists.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Grand Hotel Group tops turnover lists.

text.p: Securities in Grand Hotel Group topped turnover on Tuesday with 39.6 million securities or about 39 percent of the company's issued capital trading.
The bulk of the trade was in one line of 39.36 million securities specialled through County Natwest Securities at a price of A$2.05 each.
Brokers said the sale appeared to be the 39 percent stake purchased by Singapore-based Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd in January.
Tuan Sing bought the stake from Dutch finance house ING Barings for A$2.05 per share. ING Barings held the stake through its previous interest in McIntosh Securities.
Grand Hotel shareholders approved Tuan Sing's purchase of ING's stake on March 11.
Grand Hotel Group securities closed a cent lower at A$1.96 on turnover of 39.8 million securities.
